    *   The "six areas" refer to "job security, basic living needs, operations of market entities, food and energy security, stable industrial and supply chains, and the normal functioning of primary-level governments."
    *   Choice (A) mixes items from the "six fronts" (employment, financial sector, foreign trade, expectations) with items from the "six areas" (basic living needs, food and energy security). Therefore, this description is incorrect.
